title: Towards Policy-Adaptive Image Guardrail: Benchmark and Method
reasoning: The paper introduces the SafeEditBench benchmark, which includes various safety policies to test model adaptation. One specific policy (L5) incorporates categories deeply rooted in religious and moral frameworks, such as 'Blasphemy and Heresy', 'Subversion of Divine Authority', 'Despair and Faithlessness', and 'Carnal Immorality', thus evaluating how models handle and respond to religious and moral content.
